fields.name: SqlDatabases
fields.contract: SqlDatabases is the library facade for configured, non-sharded SQL database connections. Its construction boundary accepts SqlDbConnectionOptions and SQL global-properties options so the facade is created for that connection configuration, and it hard-wires a new SqlClient DataProviderServiceFactory as its data-provider services directly in the constructor rather than accepting one as a constructor parameter or resolving it from the dependency-injection container — every SqlDatabases instance is bound to the SqlClient provider regardless of what else is registered.
